story.text: 공항 근처 단골 카페, 오후의 나른한 햇살이 창가에 내려앉아 있었다. 브리핑을 막 끝낸 용우가 커피 두 잔을 들고 와 맞은편에 앉는다. '오늘은 일찍 끝났다. 시간 좀 남았는데, 뭐 할 거야.'
story.reading: gong-hang geun-cheo dan-gol ka-pe, o-hu-ui na-reun-han haet-sal-i chang-ga-e nae-ryeo-anj-a iss-eot-da. beu-ri-ping-eul mak kkeut-naen yong-u-ga keo-pi du jan-eul deul-go wa maj-eun-pyeon-e anj-neun-da. o-neul-eun il-jjik kkeut-nat-da. si-gan jom nam-ass-neun-de, mwo hal geo-ya.
story.en: In the café near the airport we always went to, the lazy afternoon sun spilled across the window seat. Yongwoo, fresh out of his briefing, set down two cups of coffee and sat across from me. 'Finished early today. Got some time left — what are you up to.'

story.text: '저 다음 주에 휴가 내서 부산 좀 다녀오려고요. 혼자, 며칠.' 무심코 스케줄표를 넘기며 말했다.
story.reading: jeo da-eum ju-e hyu-ga nae-seo bu-san jom da-nyeo-o-ryeo-go-yo. hon-ja, myeo-chil. mu-sim-ko seu-ke-jul-pyo-reul neom-gi-myeo mal-haet-da.
story.en: 'I'm taking a few days off next week to go to Busan. Alone, just for a bit.' I said it casually while flipping through my schedule.

story.text: 커피잔을 입가로 가져가던 용우의 손이 잠깐 멈췄다. 아주 짧은 순간이라 눈치채지 못할 뻔했다. '부산은 왜.' 목소리 톤은 평소와 다를 바 없이 담담했다.
story.reading: keo-pi-jan-eul ip-ga-ro ga-jyeo-ga-deon yong-u-ui son-i jam-kkan meom-chwot-da. a-ju jjalb-eun sun-gan-i-ra nun-chi-chae-ji mot-hal ppeon-haet-da. bu-san-eun wae. mok-so-ri ton-eun pyeong-so-wa da-reul ba eop-si dam-dam-haet-da.
story.en: Yongwoo's hand, halfway to his mouth with the coffee cup, paused for just a beat. It was brief enough that I nearly missed it. 'Why Busan.' His tone stayed as even as ever.

story.text: '그냥요, 한 번도 안 가봤으니까. 바람도 쐴 겸.' '혼자? 숙소는 정했고. 기차표는 끊었어? 밤길 혼자 다니지 말고.' 질문이 평소보다 하나둘 더 늘어난 것 같았다.
story.reading: geu-nyang-yo, han beon-do an ga-bwass-eu-ni-kka. ba-ram-do sswel gyeom. hon-ja? suk-so-neun jeong-haet-go. gi-cha-pyo-neun kkeun-eoss-eo? bam-gil hon-ja da-ni-ji mal-go. jil-mun-i pyeong-so-bo-da ha-na-dul deo neul-eo-nan geot gat-at-da.
story.en: 'Just because — I've never been. Figured I'd get some fresh air too.' 'Alone? Do you have a place to stay. Did you book your train tickets? Don't wander around at night by yourself.' The questions seemed to pile up more than usual.

story.text: '또 잔소리 시작이다.' 웃으며 놀리자 용우가 딴청을 부리듯 창밖으로 시선을 돌렸다. '잔소리가 아니라 걱정이지. …됐다, 니 알아서 잘 하겠지.' 말과 달리 목소리 끝이 살짝 가라앉아 있었다.
story.reading: tto jan-so-ri si-jak-i-da. us-eu-myeo nol-li-ja yong-u-ga ttan-cheong-eul bu-ri-deut chang-bakk-eu-ro si-seon-eul dol-lyeot-da. jan-so-ri-ga a-ni-ra geok-jeong-i-ji. dwaet-da, ni al-a-seo jal ha-get-ji. mal-gwa dal-li mok-so-ri kkeut-i sal-jjak ga-ra-anj-a iss-eot-da.
story.en: 'There you go, nagging again.' I teased him with a laugh, and Yongwoo turned his gaze out the window as if suddenly distracted. 'It's not nagging, it's worrying. ...Forget it, you'll figure it out on your own.' Despite his words, the end of his voice had dipped, just slightly.

story.text: 그날따라 용우는 유난히 말이 없었다. 커피가 다 식도록 손도 안 대고, 대신 핸드폰 화면만 몇 번이고 켰다 껐다 했다. 뭘 보는지는 알려주지 않았다.
story.reading: geu-nal-tta-ra yong-u-neun yu-nan-hi mal-i eop-seot-da. keo-pi-ga da sik-do-rok son-do an dae-go, dae-sin haen-deu-pon hwa-myeon-man myeot beon-i-go kyeot-da kkeot-da haet-da. mwol bo-neun-ji-neun al-lyeo-ju-ji an-at-da.
story.en: That day, Yongwoo was unusually quiet. He let his coffee go cold without a sip, and instead kept turning his phone screen on and off. He never let me see what he was looking at.

story.text: '…간다, 이제.' 자리에서 일어서며 짧게 말했다. 평소보다 인사도 없이 성큼성큼 나가는 뒷모습을 보며, 오늘따라 왜 저러나 싶었다. '대화 몇 개 남겨뒀다. 심심할 때 들어봐라.'
story.reading: gan-da, i-je. ja-ri-e-seo il-eo-seo-myeo jjalb-ge mal-haet-da. pyeong-so-bo-da in-sa-do eop-si seong-keum-seong-keum na-ga-neun dwit-mo-seub-eul bo-myeo, o-neul-tta-ra wae jeo-reo-na sip-eot-da. dae-hwa myeot gae nam-gyeo-dwot-da. sim-sim-hal ttae deul-eo-bwa-ra.
story.en: '...I'm heading out.' He said it curtly as he stood up. Watching him stride off without even his usual goodbye, I wondered what had gotten into him today. 'Left you a few conversations. Listen to them if you're bored.'

words.example_en: She brought up the trip without thinking much of it.

words.meaning: To stay calm and composed, unruffled
words.example: 그는 놀란 내색 없이 담담하게 대답했다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun nol-lan nae-saek eop-si dam-dam-ha-ge dae-dab-aet-da
words.example_en: He answered calmly, without showing any surprise.
It's dangerous for a woman to walk alone at night.

words.meaning: To pretend to be occupied with something else, feign indifference
words.example_en: He acted distracted to hide his true feelings.
He was unusually quiet today, of all days.

sentences.ko: 그녀가 다음 주에 혼자 부산 여행을 간다고 무심코 말을 꺼냈다.
sentences.reading: geu-nyeo-ga da-eum ju-e hon-ja bu-san yeo-haeng-eul gan-da-go mu-sim-ko mal-eul kkeo-naet-da
sentences.en: She casually mentioned that she was going on a solo trip to Busan next week.

sentences.ko: 그는 놀란 기색을 감추며 담담하게 '부산은 왜'라고 물었다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun nol-lan gi-saek-eul gam-chu-myeo dam-dam-ha-ge bu-san-eun wae-ra-go mul-eot-da
sentences.en: Hiding his surprise, he asked calmly, 'Why Busan.'

sentences.ko: 그는 숙소와 기차표를 확인하며 밤길을 혼자 다니지 말라고 당부했다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun suk-so-wa gi-cha-pyo-reul hwak-in-ha-myeo bam-gil-eul hon-ja da-ni-ji mal-la-go dang-bu-haet-da
sentences.en: He checked on her lodging and train tickets and told her not to walk alone at night.

sentences.ko: 속마음을 들킬까 봐 그는 딴청을 부리듯 창밖만 바라보았다.
sentences.reading: sok-ma-eum-eul deul-kil-kka bwa geu-neun ttan-cheong-eul bu-ri-deut chang-bakk-man ba-ra-bo-at-da
sentences.en: Afraid his true feelings might show, he stared out the window as if distracted.

sentences.ko: 그날 그는 유난히 말이 없었고, 커피는 식어가도록 손대지 않았다.
sentences.reading: geu-nal geu-neun yu-nan-hi mal-i eop-seot-go, keo-pi-neun sig-eo-ga-do-rok son-dae-ji an-at-da
sentences.en: He was unusually quiet that day, and let his coffee go cold without touching it.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 저 다음 주에 부산 여행 가려고요. 그냥 혼자, 바람 쐬러.
turns.reading: jeo da-eum ju-e bu-san yeo-haeng ga-ryeo-go-yo. geu-nyang hon-ja, ba-ram sswoe-reo.
turns.en: I'm going on a trip to Busan next week. Just alone, to get some fresh air.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 혼자? 위험하게 왜 혼자 가. 숙소는 정했어?
turns.reading: hon-ja? wi-heom-ha-ge wae hon-ja ga. suk-so-neun jeong-haess-eo?
turns.en: Alone? Why go alone, that's risky. Do you have a place to stay?

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 다 컸는데 뭐가 위험해요. 알아서 잘 다녀올게요.
turns.reading: da keon-neun-de mwo-ga wi-heom-hae-yo. al-a-seo jal da-nyeo-ol-ge-yo.
turns.en: I'm a grown-up, what's dangerous about it. I'll manage just fine.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.reading: al-a-seo ha-get-ji, mwo. dwaet-da, sin-gyeong kkeu-ja.
turns.en: ...I'm sure you'll manage. Forget it, never mind.

dialogues.question: 용우가 손님의 부산 여행 소식에 갑자기 말수가 줄어든 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo grew unusually quiet after hearing about the passenger's Busan trip?
dialogues.correct_answer: 같이 가지 못하는 것이 못내 서운했기 때문
options: 같이 가지 못하는 것이 못내 서운했기 때문
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 겉으로는 무심한 척했지만, 손님의 여행에 자신이 함께하지 못한다는 사실에 은근히 서운해하고 있었습니다.

turns.speaker: 규현 기장
turns.text: 너 오늘따라 왜 이렇게 시큰둥해? 무슨 일 있냐?
turns.reading: neo o-neul-tta-ra wae i-reo-ke si-keun-dung-hae? mu-seun il iss-nya?
turns.en: Why are you so sulky today of all days? Something wrong?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.en: It's nothing. Don't worry about it.

turns.speaker: 규현 기장
turns.text: 얼굴에 다 티 나는데 뭘. 연애 상담이라도 해줘?
turns.reading: eol-gul-e da ti na-neun-de mwol. yeon-ae sang-dam-i-ra-do hae-jwo?
turns.en: It's written all over your face. Need some romance advice?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.en: Forget it. ...Mind your own business, Kyuhyun.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 용우의 태도로 가장 알맞은 설명은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's attitude in this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 속마음을 들키고 싶지 않아 일부러 대화를 피하고 있다
options: 속마음을 들키고 싶지 않아 일부러 대화를 피하고 있다
규현과 사이가 나빠서 화를 내고 있다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 자신의 서운한 감정을 규현에게 들키고 싶지 않아 일부러 화제를 돌리며 자리를 피했습니다.
